notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

I have been working hard on Galactic Mining Corp and have been listening to the awesome feedback from the forums, discord and reviews (good and bad) and have made some changes and additions I hope you will enjoy!

Here is whats in this patch

 Added - 7 new completionist medals added with BIG STAT PRIZES. These can also be viewed in Office.
    [olist]
 All the Cores - Drill every core in the game
     Coretrium Complete - Complete the Coretrium
     All the Crew - Obtain and max level all crew
     Champion Explorer - Uncover all maps
     Upgrade all Items - ... all items upgraded
     Research Genius - Complete all research squares
     Material Master - Upgrade all tiles [/olist]
 Added - New monster - Blockhead
 Added - Breaking a chest has a chance of releasing a TREASURE BONSON!!
 Added - MONSTER INFESTATION DETECTED! Some drill sites are now infested! (lots of monsters)
 Added - Some drill sites are now Swiss cheesed! (Lots of gaps)
 Added - Nano Drills now give XP for both tiles and Items they bring back

 Fixed - Auto drilling movement getting stuck on things
 Fixed - Correct number of rooms available now shown in Room Upgrade UI list.
 Fixed - Issue with some flavour text disappearing in galaxy map
 Fixed - Issue with option menu not displaying correctly
 Fixed - Typos and grammar errors

 Changed - Re balanced late game progress and reduced grind
 Changed - Reduced XP requirements of end game tile upgrades
 Changed - Decrease the difficulty of planet Apollo
 Changed - Tweaks to many drill location stats
 Changed - Nano drill cool-down reduced
 Changed - Nano drills have a better chance of finding rarer materials
 Changed - Monsters can spawn closer to each other and in more random ways
 
HOTFIXES/CHANGES SINCE PATCH---------------------------------------

HOTFIX - A few people may have been able to get INFINITE DRILL POWER due to an exploit in this patch! This has now been addressed. 

HOTFIX - An issue was identified where nano drills were causing items to level up incorrectly. This has now been fixed.

HOTFIX 28.07.21 - A few people caught a bug in which they could not get the final item upgrade achievement (with item upgrade numbers exceeding total in game). This has now been addressed. Pressing the "Sync" button in the achievements screen of the office should provide the missing achievement. This only affected a handful of people caught between the major patch release and the hot fix later that day and only those who used nano drills in this short period of time.

HOTFIX 30.07.21 - Monster infestations have been reduced slightly across all infested locations.

HOTFIX 06.08.21 - Monster infestations have been reduced again to a more manageable level. I very much appreciate the feedback I have received about these. 

HOTFIX 06.08.21 -  For those who caught the item level bug. I have added a fix as best I could to help your save file. If you go to the office/achievement screen and press the sync button it should now return your item levels to the correct max and it SHOULD pop the Item completion badge and perk. You will also be awarded a load of drill tokens as this issue would have meant you could not get them all. Please let me know if this helps you. Its very difficult to test this as the issue was such a small window of time and didn't affect many people. I wanted to fix this as I feel those who were affected deserve better and I made a mistake. I hope this will fix the issue for those that were affected and I hope you are enjoying Galactic Mining Corp
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is quite a large update and I hope you find the changes and additions even more fun. I am so thankful for all the amazing support I have received for the game and I hope many of you will continue to enjoy the game long into the future.

Happy drilling and much love

Anthony
windybeard

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I have been working hard to make Galactic Mining Corp even greater! Thanks to your amazing feedback and suggestions I have added another set of fixes and additions.

Here is whats in this patch...

 Added a second control method. Several users with hand related injuries/problems have stated that extended play causes them discomfort. I want to do everything I can to make Galactic Mining Corp fun for everyone. Now you can switch to "Auto drill" mode in the options menu. This will make the drill automatically follow the mouse, when the left mouse button is held down you will stop until you release the button.
 Crit strike has had a make over. Hitting a crit will now cause damage to some surrounding tiles in front of your drill. A crit strike will cause (base drill damage + crit damage) to the tile being drilled and crit damage to surrounding tiles. This affects tiles, crates and chests!
 You can now hit crit strikes on chests and crates.
 Crit stike chance increased by 30%. You will see many more of them. I also increased the size of the crit strike visual effect.
 New Tooltip added . You can now mouse over tiles and items in the end of mission screen to see the names of the tiles and items.
 A large amount of optimisation should reduce frame rate issues when drilling large planets with tons of powerups.
 Reduced the cost of Mighty Obelisk of Research investment site by a considerable amount. 
 Fixed an issue where having to much money made your cash turn negative. Capped at 2 Billion.
 Fixed the confusing wording of the Sunset Silo. It now refers to crit damage in its description.
 Fixed several sound effects not applying the player chose SFX volume
 Fixed a strange issue causing some chests to be empty in the explore screen
 Corrected a load of spelling mistakes
 Fixed an issue where giant worm would spawn twice in same place.

Hotfix (later the same day) - Anyone who had their cash turn negative before the above patch should now be pulled back into the positive when first entering the HQ screen. Sorry to anyone who got stuck in negative for a while. I hope this is now fixed for you all.

Again I want to thank you all for the most amazing release. Its been an absolute joy speaking with you all about the game and its amazing to see how much people are enjoying the game. Thank you!!!

Happy drilling and much love

Anthony
Windybeard

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. 

Alongside the launch of the Galactic Mining Corp Steam trading cards I have managed to update quite a lot in the game itself. Some fixes and a few new additions!


 The infirmary level 3 upgrade no longer costs a BAJILLION coins. It now has a reasonable price.

 Late game drilling earnings will be updated correctly when numbers get really high.
 Upgrading tiles/items to max will no longer randomly leave the "level up" button visible.
 Horizontal explosive crates now kill monsters.
 fixed another load of typo's and grammar issues. 
 Fixed a rare issue in which 1 research square was not unlocking correctly
 Fixed an issue with a block break sound effect not playing every time
 Fixed an issue where unlocking space map squares behaved strangely (on rare occasions) in 3rd map bottom corner.

 Added a 5x green coin to reduce late game slow down due to coin and particle loads.
 Added a new investment site in 3rd galaxy. GO FIND IT
 Added a Sync button on the in game achievement screen which will resync with steam and unlock any achievements missed by Steam (you have to have them unlocked in that save file for Steam to find them)

Thank you all so very much for the amazing support. the last few weeks since release have been an absolute roller coaster! I sincerely hope you are all enjoying the game. Feel free to join the Windybeard Discord to discuss the game (or anything) and throw around some suggestions. I am in there most of the time. Join the Windybeard Discord

If you are one of the unfortunate few who has had their Antivirus wipe their save files, please be sure to white list Galactic Mining Corp again after this patch just in case. I am still trying to address this issue.

Happy Drilling!

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Launch Week Update
notes.notes:
Oh my days, what a launch week this has been! Thank you all so much for the enormous love you have shown for Galactic Mining Corp! On Tuesday, the game launched on Steam and the response has truly blown me away. Wow.

Galactic Mining Corp made it onto Steam's front page in "New and Trending" (and it's still there), but now also currently appears in the "Community Recommended" carousel too. The game has surpassed even my wildest expectations with more than ten times even my most optimistic sales estimates (this in addition to the huge backing the game got on Kickstarter). Over the last few days, the Steam stats have shown over a thousand concurrent players in the game during peak hours in the United States. It's incredible to see so many of you getting into the game.

I want to highlight the wonderful feedback from players. Not only have I read some wonderful reviews, but I am also grateful for the supportive messages received over Discord and Twitter - you lot are breathtaking. There are now over 150 reviews and Galactic Mining Corp's review summary is marked as "Very Positive". For those of you who followed the development on Twitch or backed the Kickstarter, you will know that the game has been refined and polished with the extra time afforded by the crowdfunding. From the feedback I have seen, it was totally worth it, so thank you all again.

As with any software release, a few bugs and edge cases have been identified by players, along with a number of feature requests and suggestions. The first Galactic Mining Corp patch was issued on Thursday and I will continue to work day and night to triage, prioritise and fix the items on the list. 

Thanks again and HAPPY DRILLING!

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,  

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - RELEASE DATE SET
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

This will be the final development update post, as I can now announce the release date for Galactic Mining Corp!

First up, over the last few weeks I have worked on squashing over 200 bugs and issues identified by my amazing team of testers who have spent collectively thousands of hours playing the game through over and over again. In particular, I'd like to thank my good pal RetroSteezy for his incredible dedication to meticulously pulling apart my game over hundreds of hours of playtime - cheers, mate! :D

Alongside all this bug fixing has been more polishing and some late-game balancing, which has been both difficult and time-consuming, but important to the overall experience. In my last update I told you that Lana_Lux had voiced Kira, the tutorial bot. She is now joined by Galactic Mining Corp's character artist, Peet Cooper, as the voice of Hogan the hangar dude. And of course, I am voicing the dodgy market seller slime alien. My thanks go to both Lana and Peet for helping bring those two characters to life.

But anyway, now onto the bit you've been waiting for. As many of you know, one of my gamedev heroes is Shigeru Miyamoto and I think one of his past quotes sums up my feelings on Galactic Mining Corp: A delayed game is eventually good. A bad game is bad forever. Galactic Mining Corp has been in development for close to two years and represents the largest investment of time I have made in any of my seven games to date. However, as I have said in the Kickstarter and the various updates, I truly believe it has been worth it. Thank you all for your patience with the release date announcement, and so with that...

Galactic Mining Corp officially releases on Tuesday 18th May 2021.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8410cc57aee6cde44ff1e389071ce3596bbae4a8.jpg

For those of you who pledged in the "New Recruit" or higher Kickstarter reward tiers, details of fulfilment applicable to each tier will be posted prior to release.

I'll finish with another big thank you to everyone for their amazing support and helping me to bring the full Galactic Mining Corp vision into reality.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,  

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #14
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

As even the world's richest people know all too well, launching on particular day is never a guarantee. Circumstances outside your control can upset even the best laid plans, and that is why I have unfortunately had a small slip in my release window. In the last update a few weeks ago, I had anticipated being able to formally announce the GMC release date sometime around mid-late March 2021. I am sorry to say this is going to be delayed by a few more weeks.

Now, first up the game itself is pretty much done. The art and music is in. The balancing has been tweaked. All the custom content is finished. The bonus in-game arcade cartridges are ready. What has happened is that my planned house move has been delayed, which has skewered my original release schedule and forced a small shift in my milestone dates.

"But Windy, why move house and try to release a game at the same time, YOU FOOL!", I hear you cry. Well, it was never intended for the two to coincide with one another, but COVID-19 and UK Stamp Duty (house move tax) have conspired to generate some delays with the buyers and sellers involved in my moving process which I have zero control over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/c6e9a229631421e9da92e17f82446f07964ce0cd.png

In order for the GMC release to be a success, I need to have a number of key things in place so that I can support community engagement, deal with bug reports, marketing queries etc which I simply can't do properly in the middle of a house move with all of my stuff in boxes. I am working hard to get the contract and logistics resolved ASAP. Once I have a confirmed exchange date for house contracts, I will know when I will be in the new place and setup ready to launch. 

I want you all to know that I am not sat here idle - I am using this additional time to keep adding improvements to the game, including some new animations for the HQ, plus also some new character voice overs which add yet more depth and colour to the GMC. Kira, the tutorial bot, is now voiced by fellow Twitch streamer and game dev Lana Lux

I expect to have an update on the GMC release date in the next few weeks, once the timeline on my house move and exchange dates are all confirmed. Thanks for your patience at this rather stressful time.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #13
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

It's a brand new year and I am really pleased to report that all of the crew members and HQ rooms are now finished and have been integrated into the game. Most of the artwork is now also done, with a few remaining larger static pieces for the Investment Sites still to go. I am growing the GMC universe every day with the backer content and it is shaping up really nicely. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/cc72c37a9c56a3eab8858a00f4f7ce7f88259498.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8b2f0ace7682846baf22f1a6f9ece3b4dcd39255.png

Further to extensive feedback from alpha testers, it became clear that the additional fourth galaxy was skewing the progression and spacing out the game content too far to be enjoyable. For this reason, I have decided to axe the fourth galaxy and re-structure things - the number of planets and locations will be the same, but in three galaxies rather than four. At the time the stretch goal of the fourth galaxy was created it was not anticipated that play would be negatively impacted, but this is part of the development process and we have to learn from it and respond accordingly - I don't want it to spoil the game, but rest assured that the actual content that would have been in the fourth galaxy is not being axed.

Over the next few weeks I will be addressing a number of bugs from the alpha testers and getting fixes integrated ahead of the release candidate testing. I will also be finalising those remaining Investment Site art pieces and polishing up the last bits of content.

I'll wrap up this update with some very exciting news: Based on current timeline, I expect to finish development of the game by around March 2021, with the intention to release it soon after. We're so very nearly there and I am doing my best to get it to you as soon as possible. I will make a full announcement regarding the release date in the next 6-8 weeks or so.

See you in the next update!

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love,  

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #11
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png

This update is a little different to my previous ones, but it's both important and deserving of a little context - I have decided to change the name of the game to "Galactic Mining Corp". I'm in the process of making the name change across all media platforms effective Tuesday 1st December. Please rest assured that the game is staying the same as has been promised - it is only the name that is changing (and not really by much).   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/5618fc75cc1bf1b72a2ff73a17bf11c350f9300b.png

"OK Windy, that's great, but WHY?" I hear you scream. First and foremost as time has gone by and development has progressed, it has become clear to me that the game is more than a sequel. It is Geo's successor in nearly every aspect, from the significant improvements in art and music, through to new gameplay elements and player experiences. As I consider the totality of the game, it is a standalone work in its own right - there is also no need to have played the original Geo in order to get the most out of this game.

Secondly, each game a developer releases is being thrown into a very busy, crowded marketplace full of messages from content producers such as myself. It's very difficult to get visibility and when you do, you usually just get one shot at capturing someone's interest. "Geo" doesn't mean much on its own and I am frequently asked what the original game is about. By changing to "Galactic Mining Corp", it instantly tells players what sort of gaming experience lies ahead of them - you're in space, you're mining, and you're running a business. I ran the name change past some friends, industry professionals, and players of my games - the response was as clear as it was positive - it is a much better name.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/dd6d894f41c41c042d1aec26dba4609ab2a90a40.png

And finally, over the course of releasing half a dozen commercial games, I consider myself to be more experienced and, hopefully, more professional in my approach. Being an indie developer in a crowded bazaar of gaming and entertainment offerings means that changes such as this can be inevitable - it's moving with the ebbs and flows of what people are looking for, better understanding not only what but also how they search for, access, and enjoy new content and experiences. The change in name should lead people more directly and more clearly towards the game.

This journey, made possible by the generous support of my wonderful Kickstarter backers, has been about making the game the best it can be. The extra time to enhance the art, game mechanics, and content will really make it shine, and with the name changing to Galactic Mining Corp, I hope it will bring in even more players to share that experience with you.

During this transition to a new name there may be changes to how Geo 2/ Galactic Mining Corp is found and handled by Steam. Certain aspects of this change have to be handled by Steam themselves so this process is ongoing. Hopefully this slight turbulence won't last long and I will keep you updated along the way.

Twitch | Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Facebook | Patreon | Steam | Youtube

Much love, 

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png
Geo 2 has been renamed as Galactic Mining Corp

Hey everyone

So much has happened with both Geo 2 and my other games since the last update. Rest assured I am working on Geo 2 every single day and doing my very best to make Geo 2 the sequel to remember! So enough words Windybeard, tell me what you have done!

Effects and Polish
Now this is one of my favourite stages of a games development. Now that I am fast approaching the later stages of development I have been replacing, updating and polishing everything that needs it. Little tweaks to explosions, small visual effects, colour changes and rearranging things that didn't quite feel right. The list of these small jobs is too long to list here but after several weeks of this the game has leapt forward in terms of quality.  Below are a few screenies that show some of these updates and effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/314ebc227a164acf312c450370d856c185af3070.png

Caves and variety
I have started ramping up the variety and events you can find while drilling. One of my intents with Geo 2 is to give you all the sense of never really knowing what to expect when drilling toward the core. Even after many hours of play I want you to find new things to interact with, run from and even laugh at. I have added lots of new “cave events” to find. These are small random things you can find, some help you, some don't but they are never negative. There are common ones and rare ones. The rare “cave events” can be super useful. Here is a fun one to have a peep at.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/e3edcc7521aa2d7c0c8a35f467700d35fd5500e4.gif

Kickstarter art
For the Geo 2 Kickstarter I offered backers the opportunity to purchase different assets in the game such as rooms, planets and even crew members. Here are some of the new assets I designed based on the awesome ideas of the Kickstarter backers. It was awesome to see how creative people can be and some of the ideas were genuinely amusing. Here are some of the planets the crazy Kickstarter backers came up with!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8b39d49e209501cd7ab64bb2b29fe41fb9aab6e2.png

Bugs smashing
As with the polish stage I detailed above, I have now moved head first into the pulsating belly of the bug beast. Every little annoyance, every little mistake or bug is being chronicled and obliterated. Its a challenging, often annoying but very satisfying part of late stage development. Still a few to go but its really starting to come together now.

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/516f10d7fb4c5dd7a8439b2a94236338c939419f.png

Hey everyone

In this update I will explain the many ways in which you can progress and upgrade almost every thing in the game. One of the main game play aspects of Geo 2 is the freedom to choose how and when you level up whatever you wish to upgrade. The choice is yours and those choices are never wrong. Every upgrade helps in some way or another. 

Last week I went into detail about the drilling system in Geo 2 and in order for you to successfully drill planets and make money you need to become stronger and more resilient to the many forces at play trying to stop you achieving this. In short you will always want to increase your stats!

Basic Stats
There are a boat load of stats to manipulate in Geo 2 however you have a small set of base stats that are key to progression. These stats are always shown to you in the top left of the screen, you can toggle this on and off if you want to. The stats are as follows...
[olist] Drill Power - This is the amount of damage you will do to a tile when drilling it
 Drill HP - This is the amount of Hit Points/Health your drill has
 Crit Strike - This is the amount of extra damage you will do when a critical hits
 Resistances - Fire, Ice, Acid, Radiation and Dark. These are your resistances to elemental damage received when drilling affected locations.[/olist]
Also shown in the top left is...[olist]
 Cash - How much money you have
 Core fragments - How many core fragments you have, spend these in the Coretrium perk tree
 Drill Tokens - These are required to upgrade drill components
 Geo level - Your overall level. This goes up with every bit of progress you make.[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/57a9dc5e267d44c542950af6bda8833b9db06002.png

Upgrades
There are a huge number of ways you can increase your stats. The most important being building up your HQ. At the start of the game your HQ will consist of a little building with 2 vacant rooms. Luckily you are also given 2 room blueprints so you can build these in the vacant rooms. Each room has its own specific stats that when built are instantly added to yours. 

The rooms stats mirror your own so you can see exactly what stat increases you are getting when the room is built. There are 2 further key bits of information to note "Crew slots" across the bottom, and "Crew Xp Modifier"

Each room allows you to place up to 4 crew members into that room, when adding crew members you will add their stats to the room stats and ultimately to your drill stats. Building rooms and adding crew members is how you get ahead. Crew members and rooms can be unlocked throughout the game and I will touch further on this in a later update. When crew members are in a room they will receive XP from drilling and the "Crew Xp Modifier" shows you how much XP they will get, in this instance they will receive and extra 20% XP! BONUS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/5801385639a9035a67ad58c5e50b3c149fd5a5d5.png

Crew Upgrades
As explained above crew members gain XP from drilling. Having crew members not assigned to rooms means they will not receive XP at all. When a crew member is stuffed full of XP they can be upgraded via the crew menu. What is important to note is that crew bonus stats unlocked through this process are added to your stats FOREVER regardless if the crew is in a room or not! These are incredibly important and upgrading crew members will make you very powerful. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8fc5149ffd53f6d5993a53eb5464c76692af76f6.png

Room Upgrades
Every room can also be upgraded 3 times. These upgrades do not give you stat boosts however they do permanently increase your cash multiplier. Once upgraded the cash multiplier boost is applied regardless if the room is built in the HQ or not.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/7f480e861970778021ed98c6e89e124013973dd2.png

Collection
When you drill tiles or collect items in Geo 2 they are recorded and kept. Every single block you drill is yours and has many different ways of helping you progress. One such way is by upgrading the Tiles and items themselves. Each tile has a XP requirement and can be upgraded 3 times. When a Tile is upgraded its value when drilled increases by 50%. So a tile worth 10 gold will now be worth 15 gold! Not only does it increase in value but you will also obtain a "Drill Token". Drill Tokens can be spent upgrading the drill many drill components you find throughout the game. I will explain more about the drill customisations and upgrading in a later Update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/f05ab441bf4e0b57e320e759cfcaf612dd8e20b9.png

Coretrium
The coretrium is by far the most important thing to upgrade in Geo 2. It is the very core (Pun intended) aspect of your success. Every planet you drill has a core, smash that core open to get core fragments. These fragments can be spent inside the "Coretrium" to unlock huge perks. These perks are percentage based and are applied over your normal stats. Things like "+10% to drill power", these are huge upgrades.
Also in the coretrium are 2 special nodes. 
HQ Uprade - Will increase the size of your HQ by 2 additional rooms
Galaxy Map - Will unlock an entire new additional galaxy map to explore

As you can see these are very very important upgrades and should always be your priority.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/3ad544a9073d3024d1acf916beb471550fc4ae92.png

Geo Level
Your "Geo lv" is your overall progression level. Every thing you do in Geo will grant you Geo Xp, drilling a planet core, upgrading a crew member, exploring space, upgrading a tile and much more. Every little upgrade will add xp to your Geo level. When this is ready to upgrade it will flash and clicking on it will level you up and provide you with great rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/41baa09fb422285079d6d1f2be7be289956f127e.gif

There are many other little upgrades and ways to progress in Geo 2 that you will find as you play the game and every single upgrade no matter how small will help you progress further. Get ready to upgrade like you have never upgraded before!

Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/516f10d7fb4c5dd7a8439b2a94236338c939419f.png

Hey everyone

In this update I will be highlighting the basics of the all important drilling in Geo2. Drilling earns you money and loot. Cash is king in Geo 2. Everything from exploring a galaxy to building a new room costs money and you are going to need to earn a lot of it!

Exploration I covered in last weeks update, when exploring you can find a huge variety of alien worlds to drill. There are 5 types of location to drill; Comets, Moons, Planets, Gas Giants and lastly stars. As you can imagine drilling to the core of a comet is easier than reaching the centre of a star! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/ad9b73621082790afd7689cd54fb5ac6f26dadbc.png

Locations
Every location is unique. Understanding the stats of a location can really help you..
Depth - How many rows of Tiles (Drillable blocks) to reach the core.
Best Depth - The deepest you managed to drill in this location
Gravity - Effects the density of tiles which increases as you go deeper. The deeper you go the harder the tiles are. This stat also affects how fast the elemental effects increase.
Element - Which elemental effect the location has and how strong it is.
Tiles - Which tiles you found in the location (Star values show rarity in location)
Items - Which items you found
Cores - How many times you have drilled the core (Max 3 per location)

Each and every location in Geo 2 that you find in space is different and every time you drill that location it will generate a different layout. These locations are made up of a set list of Tiles (Drillable blocks) that represent 1km in depth. The list comprises of 4 to 10 preset Tiles of increasing rarity and each with their own unique stats and data (such as health, cash value) Drilling the Tiles will earn you cash and you will also keep the tiles you drilled to use in many other places in the game (Researching new rooms, collection and Fusion, Crew contracts), I will touch on these systems in future updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/ed6ca53b0c0fbc7a6e768a935161be1195ba98a4.png

Powerups
Drilling these Tiles will damage your drill over time, it takes a skill to identify the weaker tiles and plot a good course downward to the core of the planet. Alongside the Tiles is a large range of other cool things to drill, treasure chests litter the planets and give a nice cash boost alongside a large number of power-up crates. New crates are unlocked as you progress through the game and will be found in the procedurally generated landscapes. Everything you drill and collect is recorded. Not only in your collection of loot but also in relation to the location itself. This means you can check to see what has been found in every location you have drilled but only once you have found it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/e49a145b7522b0836ba94544bd1493bd21ee4226.gif

Elements & Caves
Some planets have elemental effects. The elements in Geo 2 are Fire, Ice, Acid, Radiation and Dark energy. Your resistances to these elements will be crucial in succeeding on these locations. The deeper you drill the stronger the effect of the element and the more damage you will take over time.

When drilling these locations you may come across little cave areas in the Tiles. These cave areas can be home to some amazing bonuses and power-ups. There are lots and lots of helpful, fun and crazy things to find in these caves. They are randomly selected from pools of increasingly rare events. They can range from a health recovery station that will replenish your health when you dock to strange alien underground jungles full of cash and loot. Keep an eye out for these as they can really give you a boost

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/f0cb1351e389d61036e7b01406442ac5291f99e5.png

Monsters
ALIENS MONSTERS AHHHHH! Some of the over 100 locations in Geo 2 are home to a wide variety of hostile subterranean monsters. They will chase you, explode if you go near them, poison tiles and much more. Tactical use of certain crates and power-ups can kill them or just avoid them as best you can.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/44285ce48206bc28996b8e87304c5cb868f156eb.gif

The Core
The core! At the bottom of every drill site is a spinning core stuffed with loot. If you can make it all the way down you can destroy the core. When a core is destroyed it will shower you with Cash, research coins (More on this in a future update), Items and lastly core fragments. Core fragments are a super currency in Geo 2 and are used to purchase super powerful upgrades and stat boosts as well as increasing the size of your Head quarters and unlocking new galaxies. Drilling cores is the fastest way to progress in Geo 2 and should always be your goal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/c8a7c4d7b5dbb97be46bbd82e13153863d8cabc9.png

There is so much more to drilling than what was covered in this update however I hope it gives you a great insight into some of the mechanics and cool stuff you can do/find when drilling in Geo 2.
Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/516f10d7fb4c5dd7a8439b2a94236338c939419f.png

Hey everyone

In this update I will shed some light on the exploration system of Geo 2, what sort of things you can find and where Geo 2 improves on Geo 1 in this regard

Exploration
Exploration is a huge part of Geo 2. By exploring you find all manner of awesome, useful and frankly weird things. When you enter a galaxy (of which there are several) you will begin in the centre. You can explore in any direction you wish, there is no set path however the further from the centre you explore the more expensive it gets, the trade off being the further you go the greater the reward

The centre of the galaxy is generally more densely packed however the locations you can find further out will be far harder but considerably more valuable. 

Exploring is super simple, click on a "?" square and right click it to uncover whats underneath (If you have the cash of course), if you are lucky enough to find something BIG it will clear the entire object of "?" squares! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/d0b086a927efb99daeadd5e3f77d2545fcac596d.gif

The map system is different from Geo 1. In Geo 1 you would pay to unlock small quadrants of space that would have some places to drill and other goodies to find. In Geo 2 the maps are significantly bigger, around 5 times bigger than the biggest map in Geo 1! The new map system is hand designed by me to allow for a much more balanced experience. As you progress through Geo 2 you will unlock new maps with even greater challenge and even better rewards.

Improvements and new stuff!
Mini Map - You now have a mini map of the galaxy to help you move around, as the maps are quite large it is helpful to be able to see what you have found in the area. You can also move around via this mini map by clicking on the objects within it.

Crew Contracts - A returning feature but greatly improved. You will find crew contracts out in space. When you enter one you will be greeted by a potential new crew member to hire. they have a little story and a request. If you can obtain the objects they desire then they will come and work for you!
Crew contracts are recorded and accessible from any map at any time once you have met the crew member so unlike Geo 1 you will not need to revist them in order to fulfil the request and grab a new crew member! Super useful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9245098d99ed01f2b5d059971933ffdc0b302687.png

Drill Hangars - A whole new feature in Geo 2. Dotted around the galaxies are drill hangars. The Hangar dude wants key cards and cash to open the hangar and for you to get the new drill component. Hidden around the galaxies are key cards. Collect the amount required and hand over the dosh and the new drill component is yours! 
Your drill is customizable and upgradable in Geo 2 and this is one of the ways you can obtain new parts to use and upgrade! (More on this system in another update)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/27d1b4110b73f37ad836f8fa007ce6019f0f4c40.png

Points of Interest - Spread throughout the galaxy are these locations. When you enter one of these you will be given an awesome image of the location and a story to enjoy, you will also get some loot for finding this location and often hints and tips to help you on your adventure. The galaxies of Geo 2 are rich with stories and characters for you to enjoy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8f9d04bed2525e6dffa42ec1416d7ceadf50a7ee.png

There is of course lots of drillable locations for you to find, each different and each stuffed full of loot to grab! comets, moons, planets and gas giants return from Geo 1 however now you have a new goliath waiting to be drilled. Have you ever drilled a star core before?

There is much more to find out in the galaxies of Geo 2, and much more to come. You are never far from finding something awesome!

Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/ad8338ad5765d2bc282e529a4d8e8cbc458bc338.png

Hey everyone!

As this is the first development update I will start from the beginning and shed some light on Geo 2, its origins and its development.

Geo 1 was a game I made and released back in Jan 2017. It was great fun to make and well liked by those who played it. After Geo 1 was released I made several other games you may or may not know about (Dreamstones, Scud Frenzy, Puzzle Plunder and RagTag) before deciding it was time to revisit Geo and make the sequel Geo 1 deserved.

Geo 2 officially started development in March 2019 and as of the time of writing this has been in solid development for just over a year. Its awesome to be working in the Geo universe again.

What is Geo 2?
Geo 2 is a game about building and expanding an intergalactic mining corporation. You do this by exploring uncharted space, finding comets, moons, planets and drilling them. By drilling them you earn cash (among other things) that you can spend to upgrade just about everything in the game. Upgrade your corporate headquarters, Hire crew members, build new facilities, unlock new  drill parts, upgrade each and every single type of mud or rock you find, research new facilities, unlock new galaxies and much more!
Each and every time you drill a planet in Geo 2 the planets layout changes, no two runs are the same!
There is far more to Geo 2 than this however that is the core (pun intended) loop of the gameplay, take your time upgrading things, explore space, find some weird and wonderful locations and then drill, drill drill! When drilling there is no penalty for running out of health and your drill exploding, you keep whatever you had when you exploded and you can just try again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/e2e2759bf5307a649c4ef46368d0b4616de50646.png

When drilling the main idea is to get to the core of the location and drill it, upon doing so you earn "Core fragments" which can be spent in the "Coretrium" perk tree for huge stat boosts, special perks and major HQ upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/268d7ab628f1bf6f673b98fe09f7308c1a9160fc.gif

Geo 2 is packed full of crazy and awesome crew members to locate and hire. There will be over 60 crew members to find and acquire... Gotta hire them all! There will be returning crew members from Geo 1 (I couldn't forget the banana alien Mr Banihan) alongside some awesome new arrivals and some super special secret characters you may recognise! (Big reveals in future updates)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/a4082003a363416618f3eaa01695c73e1bfdab6f.png

Geo 2 is a game very close to my heart, I really love the silly and strange universe, the colourful locations, wacky crew members and funny little stories spread throughout the game for you to find. I am excited each and every day I am working on it (and crushingly worried about making it right) and intend to make this game the very best I  can make it. I hope you are excited for Geo 2 and if you want to help me out then please spread the word about Geo 2 and bang it on your wishlist!

This development update is the first of many as I work toward completion of Geo 2. This one covers the basic idea of the game to shed some further light on the game for players both new and returning. Future development updates will drill down further (Pun intended) into specific features and cool new stuff you can expect in Geo 2.

Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)
